name: font-weight-text
title: Font Weight Text
description: Letters breathe through a variable font weight, thin to heavy and back, each on its own phase so a wave of weight rolls along the word from the middle outward.
useWhen: A headline should feel alive without moving: weight swells and relaxes letter by letter.
A calm, looping title or call to action.
avoidWhen: The layout must not shift: the letters change width as the weight changes; use caption-weight for a no-shift swell.
author: Eldora UI

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The word or phrase that breathes.

variables.label: Minimum weight
variables.description: Lightest weight of the cycle (the font floors it at 100).

variables.label: Phase offset
variables.description: Seconds of phase between neighbouring letters.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Text size in pixels. The source is built for 72px type; its pixel offsets scale with this size.
